name: Sajószentpéter (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Sajószentpéter: a blue shield with a white bend and a figure of Saint Peter, with a helm, mantling and two yellow lion supporters, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sajószentpéter arms with helm, mantling, supporters and scroll
